en: A monochrome illustrated postcard showing a lively steel toboggan or sledding track with several lanes descending from a tall wooden structure. People, mostly in late‑19th or early‑20th‑century clothing, ride sleds down the chutes while others crash or tumble at the bottom among scattered sleds, children, and dogs. On top of the ramp is a sign reading "RODEL BAHN," and at the upper left of the card is printed German text indicating the location of the steel toboggan run in Graz, specifically on Pfeifengasse.
